item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 23/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon and upper-air disturbance will affect Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be very cold and windy with a few rain patches over the region. It will remain cold over the coastal areas of Guangdong on Thursday. The monsoon will moderate slightly in the latter part of this week, but it will be rather cool in the morning and at night over the region. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China early next week.
